```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

waste_path = 'chunks_csv/moran_global_2022_waste.csv'
df_waste = pd.read_csv(waste_path)
df_adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

boroughs = sorted(df_waste['borough'].unique())
n = len(boroughs)
borough_index = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(boroughs)}

# Build symmetric binary adjacency matrix
W = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=float)
for _, row in df_adj.iterrows():
    a, b = row['borough'], row['neighbor']
    i, j = borough_index[a], borough_index[b]
    if i != j:
        W[i, j] = 1.0
        W[j, i] = 1.0

# Row-standardize
row_sums = W.sum(axis=1)
W_row = W / row_sums[:, np.newaxis]

# Get waste values in consistent borough order
x = np.array([df_waste.loc[df_waste['borough'] == b, 'Waste_value'].values[0] for b in boroughs])
z = x - np.mean(x)

# Moran's I with row-standardized weights
# I = (z' W z) / (z' z) when weights are row-standardized (since n/S0 = n/n = 1)
numerator = np.dot(z, np.dot(W_row, z))
denominator = np.dot(z, z)
I_obs = numerator / denominator

print("Observed Moran's I:", I_obs)
print("Mean z:", np.mean(z))
print("Denominator (z'z):", denominator)

# Permutation test: shuffle z values across locations, keep weights fixed
np.random.seed(42)
n_perm = 1000
I_perm = np.empty(n_perm)

for i in range(n_perm):
    z_shuffled = np.random.permutation(z)
    num_perm = np.dot(z_shuffled, np.dot(W_row, z_shuffled))
    I_perm[i] = num_perm / denominator

# p-value: proportion of permutations with I >= observed I (one-tailed test for positive autocorrelation)
p_value = np.mean(I_perm >= I_obs)

print("Permutation test p-value (one-tailed, positive):", p_value)
print("Mean of permuted I:", np.mean(I_perm))
print("Std of permuted I:", np.std(I_perm))
print("Min permuted I:", np.min(I_perm))
print("Max permuted I:", np.max(I_perm))
```
